TRAVEL ESSENTIALS · TRAVEL GUIDE

The first-timer’s guide to travelling Vietnam with confidence

What to arrange before departure, what to pack, and the little details that help your first days feel effortless.

7
Seven Travel Editorial TeamOctober 22, 2026 · 6 min read
THE JOURNAL

A better way to see Vietnam.

Explore at your pace with thoughtful local guidance.

Plan with confidence ↗
← More in Travel Essentials

Vietnam is wonderfully varied: lively cities, relaxed river journeys, quiet countryside and mountain landscapes. A little preparation helps you enjoy that contrast without unnecessary stress.

Confirm your entry requirements

Check passport validity and the official entry or e-visa rules for your nationality well before departure. Regulations can change, so rely on official Vietnamese government sources rather than older travel forum posts.

Prepare for more than one climate

Northern, central and southern Vietnam can have very different weather at the same time. Pack versatile layers, comfortable walking shoes and a light rain layer, then tailor your suitcase to your actual route and travel dates.

Sort out connectivity and payment

A roaming plan, eSIM or local SIM can make navigation and communication easier. Carry a little Vietnamese dong for small purchases, while using cards at suitable established businesses. Check bank fees before leaving home.

Keep the first day relaxed

After a long flight, a gentle walk, a simple meal and an early night are often better than a tightly packed sightseeing schedule. Give yourself time to settle in and enjoy the atmosphere.

✦ THE LOCAL TIP

Seven Travel tip: Keep your hotel address saved offline in both English and Vietnamese for easier taxi transfers.
